title: Broccoli Potato Kugel
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, more for greasing the pan
2 large potatoes (about 2 pounds), peeled and boiled
2 pounds broccoli, cut into florets and cooked
directions: Sauté onion in 2 to 3 tablespoons oil in a small frying pan over medium heat until browned. Add garlic and stir for a minute or two. Set aside.
In large mixing bowl mash potatoes and stir in eggs, one by one, incorporating well. Add mayonnaise, matzo meal, salt and pepper, stirring well. Fold in onion and broccoli.
Grease a 9-by-13-inch baking pan and spoon in mixture, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with panko or challah crumbs. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake kugel for 50 minutes or until golden.
